methodology.samples: Three fresh processes per variant, tier and cold/staged mode. One 7140-selection memory exploration per variant. Baseline from previous lifecycle report additionally has three independent stable reference explorations.
methodology.assertions: All cold and staged path counts/checksums agree across variants and repeats. Every point checked finite. Retained memory plateau asserted after two full passes.
methodology.scope: V8 geometry only. Module import, Hermes, React, Skia/native memory and on-device frame times excluded. Validation sink adds overhead. Cached-frame redraws JS layers, not MiniGlobe SkPath cache.
methodology.assetControl: Both variants use the same regenerated assets; only border arc indices added, existing fields verified against git HEAD as identical. Border stitching runs at runtime in reference; generation time in candidate.

decision.change: Decode longitude/latitude coordinates once and share them across feature assembly. Generate quantized border stitching as arc indices in assets to preserve exact existing border order and avoid runtime stitching.
decision.tradeoff: Approximately 2 KiB extra indices per asset; modest extra decoding work in some tiers, outweighed by less coordinate allocation and no runtime border stitching. No simplified vertices or lost detail.
decision.results: Detail cold first draw median improves 24%; regional 12%, overview 10%, motion 17%. All-tier exploration retained JS heap plus ArrayBuffers decreases from about 168.6 MiB to 110.6 MiB; both plateau. V8 measurements, no device-FPS claim.

validation.generatedAssets: Existing fields match git HEAD exactly; only borders added. Every tier full land, every country and full ordered border coordinates match quantized-reference decoding in tests.
